overview.p0: The Gausin Milk Chilling Plant is engineered for reliable, hygienic performance in demanding industrial environments. Industrial-scale milk chilling plant with PHE refrigeration, insulated silos, and automated temperature monitoring for dairy processing facilities.
overview.p1: Each unit is custom-designed to your capacity, product characteristics, and plant layout requirements with SS 304/316L contact surfaces, validated process design, and full documentation.
overview.p2: Gausin provides complete engineering support from process design and fabrication through installation, commissioning, and after-sales service.
